name: postit-desk
description: Notas tipo post-it en el borde de la pantalla. Monolito modular: backend NestJS + escritorio Electron/React.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/backend && npm install --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:backend && npm run dev --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build:backend && npm run dist --prefix apps/desktop
